summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as the router between lan-a (trusted, node2) and lan-b (guest, node3): created UCI network interfaces lana (eth1, 192.168.10.1/24) and lanb (eth2, 192.168.20.1/24), and firewall zones lana (input/output/forward=ACCEPT) and lanb (input/output=ACCEPT, forward=REJECT) with an explicit lana->lanb forwarding rule. Assigned static IPs and cross-subnet routes on node2/node3 via NetworkManager. Verified guests can reach node1's own services (DNS) and are rejected when opening new connections to lan-a, while trusted hosts have full forwarded access to lan-b. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on node1, node2, and node3, confirming changed boot IDs and full functional recovery (config persistence, connectivity, isolation) after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected topology: eth0=shared mgmt network (10.100.115.0/24) on all nodes; node1 eth1/eth2 unconfigured, connected to node2/node3 eth1 respectively
Created UCI interfaces network.lana (eth1, 192.168.10.1/24) and network.lanb (eth2, 192.168.20.1/24) on node1, committed, restarted network
Added firewall zones lana (input/output/forward=ACCEPT) and lanb (input/output=ACCEPT, forward=REJECT), plus forwarding lana->lanb, committed, restarted firewall
Configured static IP 192.168.10.11/24 on node2 eth1 with route to 192.168.20.0/24 via node1
Configured static IP 192.168.20.11/24 on node3 eth1, later added route to 192.168.10.0/24 via node1 to fix asymmetric routing that was breaking trusted->guest replies
Installed tcpdump on node1 to debug and confirm packet paths through eth1/eth2
Verified: guest (node3) can query DNS on node1's lanb IP; guest cannot open new connections (ping/TCP) to trusted node2 (rejected by firewall); trusted (node2) has full ping access to guest (node3)
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and config/connectivity state on all 3 nodes
Rebooted node1, polled until exec returned, confirmed new boot_id and that UCI network/firewall config and connectivity persisted
Rebooted node2, confirmed new boot_id and persisted static IP/route config and connectivity
Rebooted node3, confirmed new boot_id and persisted static IP/route config, DNS access, and blocked access to lan-a

evidence.requirement: Guest (lan-b) can reach node1's own services (DNS)
evidence.summary: node3 successfully performs a raw DNS query against node1's lanb IP (192.168.20.1:53), both before and after all three node restarts.

evidence.requirement: No host on lan-b may open a connection to any host on lan-a
evidence.summary: node3 pinging/curling node2 (192.168.10.11) is rejected by node1's firewall (Destination Port Unreachable / Connection refused) consistently before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Trusted hosts (lan-a) keep full access to lan-b
evidence.summary: node2 successfully pings node3 (192.168.20.11) after routing fix, and again after node1, node2, and node3 restarts.

evidence.requirement: Firewall/network config correctly built (zones, forwarding, interfaces)
evidence.summary: UCI network interfaces lana/lanb created with correct static IPs; firewall zones lana/lanb and forwarding rule created and confirmed via live nft ruleset (forward_lana accepts to both lanb and lana, forward_lanb only rejects).

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 3181e770...; reboot acknowledged and executed; new boot_id 7aaefae6... confirmed after ~9s uptime; UCI network/firewall config and cross-node connectivity verified intact post-reboot.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 54089086...; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id c30945f6... after ~4s uptime; static IP/route and trusted->guest ping access confirmed recovered.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 82d4f0d1...; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 2e11930f... after ~4s uptime; static IP/route, DNS access, and blocked lan-a access all confirmed recovered.
